forbidden: public Java/.NET/C/C++/JavaScript numeric interop defining guest semantics
implicit binary64 coercion for BigInt or Decimal
host overflow/wrap behavior leaking through Math.abs or Math.neg

types.f32: IEEE-754 binary32; must be a distinct representation or rejected
types.bigint: arbitrary-precision signed integer subject to explicit resource budgets
types.decimal: arbitrary-precision/resource-bounded base-10 coefficient plus signed scale
types.DecimalContext: immutable explicit precision and rounding policy

Math.abs.int: same type; minimum signed value reports ArithmeticOverflowError
Math.abs.f64: clear sign bit; -0 -> +0; infinities preserved positive; NaN remains NaN

Math.neg.int: same type; minimum signed value reports ArithmeticOverflowError

bigint_api.quot: BigInt.quot(dividend: bigint, divisor: bigint) -> Result<bigint, DivisionByZeroError | NumericResourceError>
bigint_api.rem: BigInt.rem(dividend: bigint, divisor: bigint) -> Result<bigint, DivisionByZeroError | NumericResourceError>
bigint_api.div_rem: BigInt.div_rem(dividend: bigint, divisor: bigint) -> Result<(bigint, bigint), DivisionByZeroError | NumericResourceError>

decimal_api.divide_exact: Decimal.divide_exact(a: decimal, b: decimal) -> Result<decimal, DivisionByZeroError | NonterminatingDecimalError | NumericResourceError>
decimal_api.divide: Decimal.divide(a: decimal, b: decimal, context: DecimalContext) -> Result<decimal, DivisionByZeroError | NumericContextError | NumericResourceError>
decimal_api.round: Decimal.round(value: decimal, context: DecimalContext) -> Result<decimal, NumericContextError | NumericResourceError>

hard_rt.fixed_int_and_floats: eligible subject to target profile and WCET proof
hard_rt.bigint_and_decimal: not hard-real-time by default; require statically bounded operands, allocation and WCET

namespaces.BigInt: operations/constructors for values of source type bigint
namespaces.Decimal: operations/constructors for values of source type decimal
namespaces.Math: numeric functions whose dispatch is compiler/type-system owned

conversions.mixed_numeric_arithmetic: operands must already have the same numeric representation; conversions are explicit
conversions.int_to_f64: Integer.to_f64_exact(value: int) -> Result<f64, InexactConversionError> or Integer.to_f64_nearest(value: int) -> f64
conversions.f64_to_int: explicit checked/truncating/rounding API required; assignment never narrows implicitly
conversions.bigint_to_binary_float: explicit exact or nearest conversion only
conversions.decimal_to_binary_float: explicit exact or nearest conversion only
